_note: A layer for each Chain Fist; each makes Plated Blows' Shield bigger for the rest of the fight (Endless Bulwark, Aegisfang's apex; phase 8 part 4). It changes nothing by itself.
name: Bulwark Layer

_note: A stack for each enemy a Bulwark Burst hits; each makes later Bursts stronger for the rest of the fight (Shatterburst, Aegisfang's apex; phase 8 part 4). It changes nothing by itself.
name: Shatter Echo

_note: A stack for each enemy that falls within 1 hex of him; each makes his Grinder stronger for the rest of the fight (Grinder, Chainwarden's apex; phase 8 part 4). It changes nothing by itself.
name: Grinder's Feed

_note: More ATK and DEF for the rest of the fight, a stack for each enemy his chains drag beside him (Undertow, Chainwarden's apex; phase 8 part 4).
name: Undertow

_note: More of Undertow: ATK and DEF for the rest of the fight, a stack for each enemy dragged beside him (Undertow's Deep Current card; phase 8 part 4).
name: Deep Current

_note: A stack for every 1,000 damage he sends back; each makes what he sends back stronger for the rest of the fight (Thorned King, Spitemail's apex; phase 8 part 4). It changes nothing by itself.
name: Crown of Thorns

_note: While it lasts, a share of every hit on him is sent back (Iron Maiden, Spitemail's signature; phase 8 part 4). It changes nothing by itself: his Maiden's Spite passive reads it.
name: Iron Maiden
